entries.clue: Jealous queen of the gods who set a hundred-eyed watchman over Io
Bent iron on a long handle, dipped to retrieve gear lost overboard
Love goddess risen full-grown from the churning sea foam off Cyprus
Heavy bottle of cooking fuel lugged aboard and lashed on the front deck
Lion-skinned strongman of the twelve labours, under the Roman name Hollywood prefers
Prince who trailed thread through the man-eater's maze but forgot his white sails
Greek love god, the winged archer whose gilded arrows leave hearts helpless
Bouts of inconsolable evening crying in the first months, the cause still argued over
L-shaped crank a steerer carries to raise the paddle gear at a lock
Feather-heeled heavy breed of the old farms, and a word for a county
All-in-one stretchy nightwear with feet and poppers down the leg
Bland semi-liquid food for the very young, or drivel on the telly
Smooth spooned mush of cooked pear or parsnip, an early solid food
